verdict: 87 leads at $13.19 each this period; efficiency is improving week over week.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, MedStation received 87 leads at a cost of $13.19 per lead on $1,147.65 in Meta spend. The most recent 7 days show that spend stepped down 26.74%, yet leads fell only 7.14% — and cost per lead improved 21.11% to roughly $10.41, meaning the trimmed budget is cutting lower-quality delivery, not results. The last three days (Oct 19–21) produced 16 leads compared to 8 in the three days prior, so momentum is building heading into next week. One item holding back the full picture is website conversion tracking, which is not yet recording leads — lead counts currently rely on Meta's own reporting alone, and closing that gap is a priority in motion. Once tracking is confirmed, you will have an independent, verified lead count alongside what Meta reports.
